svg.title: Shared denoising and recurrent committing dependencies
svg.desc: Above, all configurations follow the same SGF denoising context: stored sink and recent KV condition generation of a clean latent block. Below, consecutive committing calls separately receive their own clean blocks. Base additionally reads sink and two preceding KV entries; self-only has no historical committing inputs; Ours reads the immediately preceding KV. Crosses exclude sink only from committing access, not storage or denoising. Blue lower blocks are clean latents; rust lower blocks are newly constructed KV. These are schematic types, not a shared numerical latent across policies. Inputs before the displayed window are omitted; the first shown Ours call is not a cold start.
